notes.title: Phantomancer Ver1.1.0 & Artbook
notes.notes: [p]Phantomancer Update Released! [/p][p]We’ve just released a new update for Phantomancer![/p][p][/p][h3]Phantomancer Artbook Now Available![/h3][p]A new image collection featuring character illustrations, backgrounds, stills, and more is now on sale. Check out the store page for details![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3813730/Phantomancer_Artbook/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][h3]New Mode: Hinano Adventure[/h3][p]A new variation mode has been added to the main game, featuring two unique starting decks.[/p][p]These new decks include themed cards such as Dogs and Frogs.[/p][p]Card Pick System Revamped[/p][p]With 36 new cards added, we’ve introduced a new pick system for players who have unlocked all cards.[/p][p]At the start of each run, 4 card sets (one always being “Basic”) are randomly selected. [/p][p]Cards from those sets will appear more frequently during the run.[/p][p]This helps you build better synergy while maintaining the game’s core randomness.[/p][p]New Advanced Phantoms for Each Deck[/p][p]Each starting deck now includes a unique Advanced Phantom. These cannot be pick randomly—they’re exclusive to their respective decks.[/p][p][/p][h3]New Content[/h3][list][*][p]New Mode: Hinano Adventure[/p][/*][*][p]36 New Cards[/p][/*][*][p]2 New Decks[/p][/*][*][p]2 New Enemies[/p][/*][*][p]Unique Advanced Phantoms for all starter decks[/p][/*][*][p]Card draw now biased toward 4 randomly chosen sets (if all cards are unlocked)[/p][/*][*][p]Deck selection screen now shows clear version (applies after this update)[/p][/*][*][p]Click to enlarge cards in the Library[/p][/*][*][p]Change Title BGM after clearing the game[/p][/*][*][p]Faster reward screens in Fast Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Card flip interaction polished[/p][/*][*][p]Boss preview now reflects actual order[/p][/*][*][p]Event Balance Changes[/p][/*][*][p]Ruins: Now grants a Debuff card "Confusion" when duplicating a card[/p][/*][*][p]Vital Blessing: Removed full HP restore[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Card Balance Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Komori: Now gives Delayed Mana instead of 1 Mana[/p][/*][*][p]Komori: ★1 → ★2[/p][/*][*][p]Yadoku: ★2 → ★3[/p][/*][*][p]Guidance of Destiny: ★2 → ★3[/p][/*][*][p]Reading: Exhausts[/p][/*][*][p]Tail Cut: ★1 → ★2[/p][/*][*][p]Campfire: Heal 10 → Heal 7[/p][/*][*][p]Replenish Attack Spells: Cost0 Generate 3 Fire in your hand. Exhaust.→Cost1 Generate 3 Firebolt in your hand.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Enemy Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Frenzied Beast, Harite: Apply Blunt[/p][/*][*][p]Pollen, Grave Keeper: HP reduced[/p][/*][*][p]Stinger, Swallows Slime, Failed Experiment: Weakened actions[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Other Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Various bug fixes and text changes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Phantomancer is Now Available!｜Deckbuilding Roguelike Game
notes.notes:
Starting today, the deckbuilding roguelike game Phantomancer is officially on sale!

Hitoyo, tasked with defeating a fearsome monster, sets out on a journey to the dungeon’s depths—collecting various cards along the way in order to take down the final boss.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3442280/ss_42f842bb0b70790e65dec5d5f2368307318b062d.600x338.jpg?t=1743430317[/img]

Combine a wide variety of cards and upgrades to build your own original deck, and enjoy strategic, back-and-forth battles!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3442280/Phantomancer/?l=english

notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
This is Cloudgear Games.

We’re excited to announce that Phantomancer will launch on Steam on April 11, 2025.
The game will be available at midnight JST (Japan Standard Time) on April 11.
That’s 8:00 AM PDT (Pacific Daylight Time) on April 10.

Please consider adding the game to your wishlist!
